front.title: Authoritative Resolution and Pre-Interaction Verification of Persistent Digital Agent Identities

abstract.t:
This document specifies AIN-WRP, a protocol-independent mechanism for authoritative resolution of persistent digital-agent identities and for verification of relationship-specific state before a digital agent begins a protected interaction with another registered agent or with a non-agent service or system. Each digital agent participating in AIN-WRP identity resolution is identified by its own persistent Agent Identity Number (AIN). The AIN is the stable anchor used to resolve lifecycle, operator, authority, restriction, endpoint, provenance and cryptographic evidence from sources competent for the corresponding assertions. Where the counterparty is a non-agent target, a target reference identifies the intended resource or service without being treated as an alternative digital-agent identity. AIN-WRP correlates the required evidence for the proposed interaction and can produce a Pre-Interaction Trust State or an optional State Proof. Verification does not itself execute the operation or replace receiving-domain enforcement.
The specification distinguishes persistent agent identity from credentials, proof of control, delegated authority, operational eligibility, local admission decisions and execution. AIN-WRP applies at or before the admission boundary of A2A, MCP, API, transactional, messaging and other operational protocols. An identity or target reference alone does not establish the authority, validity or eligibility of the proposed interaction.
